format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <script>window.addEventListener('load', () => customElements.whenDefined('sf-editor-overlay').then(() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.setDocument({schema: 'simai.composition.document.v1', id: 'd', profile: 'ui-layout', root: {id: 'root', type: 'layout.section', slots: {default: [{id: 'h', type: 'content.heading'}, {id: 'p', type: 'content.paragraph'}]}}}, {describe: (node) => ({label: node.id})}); o.actions = [{id: 'remove', label: 'Удалить'}]; }));</script>

probes.title: the structure tree is named by the language file; the settings are properties; actions are checked as setActions checks them
probes.covers: accessibility role tree, lang runtime.tree, settings.for, settings.actions

steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); const tree = o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-tree'); let refused = false; try { o.actions = [{id: 'Bad id', label: 'x'}]; } catch (error) { refused = error instanceof TypeError; } return tree.getAttribute('role') === 'tree' && tree.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Структура страницы' && o.for === 'canvas' && o.accepts === 'blocks' && refused && o.actions.length === 1 && o.actions[0].id === 'remove'; })()

probes.title: selecting a node sends sf-composition-overlay-select {ids, id} with node_id kept
a toolbar action sends sf-composition-overlay-apply {action, scope: entry, ids}, then the dated -action {action_id, node_id}
an insertion point sends sf-composition-overlay-insert {parent, slot, index} with parent_id kept
an action with an icon is an icon button named by its label; an unavailable one stays where it is, dimmed; an action of id and label stays a text button

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.select('h'); o.actions = [{id: 'up', label: 'Выше', icon: 'arrow_upward', shortcut: '⌥↑', disabled: true}, {id: 'remove', label: 'Удалить', icon: 'delete', tone: 'danger'}, {id: 'plain', label: 'Текст'}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); const up = o.querySelector('button[data-action=up]'); const remove = o.querySelector('button[data-action=remove]'); const plain = o.querySelector('button.sf-composition-overlay-action[data-action=plain]'); let refused = false; try { o.actions = [{id: 'x', label: 'x', tone: 'loud'}]; } catch (error) { refused = error instanceof TypeError; } return up.disabled && up.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Выше' && remove.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Удалить' && !remove.disabled && plain.textContent === 'Текст' && refused; })()

probes.title: placement is a setting: top by default, side on request, anything else reads as the default

steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); const first = o.placement; o.placement = 'side'; const second = o.getAttribute('placement'); o.removeAttribute('placement'); return first === 'top' && second === 'side' && o.placement === 'top'; })()

probes.title: a key the host mapped to an action sends apply for the selected node

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.actions = [{id: 'down', label: 'Ниже', shortcut: '⌥↓'}]; o.select('h'); o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-tree').focus(); return true; })()

probes.title: a click on the chosen node sends open {ids, id, node, point, trigger: click} once, and no select
a double click on a node selects it and sends open once, the point in canvas coordinates

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); window.__opens = []; o.addEventListener('sf-editor-overlay-open', (event) => window.__opens.push(event.detail)); const h = document.querySelector('[data-sf-composition-id=h]').getBoundingClientRect(); const c = document.getElementById('canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); window.__want = {x: h.left + 5 - c.left, y: h.top + 6 - c.top}; document.querySelector('[data-sf-composition-id=h]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: h.left + 5, clientY: h.top + 6})); return true; })()
steps.check: window.__opens.length === 1 && Math.abs(window.__opens[0].point.x - window.__want.x) < 0.01 && Math.abs(window.__opens[0].point.y - window.__want.y) < 0.01 && document.querySelector('#o [aria-selected=true]').dataset.nodeId === 'h'

probes.title: Enter on the chosen node in the tree sends open once, the point the centre of the node's box

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.select('h'); window.__opens = []; o.addEventListener('sf-editor-overlay-open', (event) => window.__opens.push(event.detail)); o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-tree').focus(); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('[data-sf-composition-id=h]').getBoundingClientRect(); const c = document.getElementById('canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const point = window.__opens[0]?.point; return window.__opens.length === 1 && Math.abs(point.x - (h.left - c.left + h.width / 2)) < 0.01 && Math.abs(point.y - (h.top - c.top + h.height / 2)) < 0.01; })()

probes.title: passive: a click in the chosen node reaches an editable inside it, nothing is selected or opened, Enter opens nothing; off again, the selection is kept and a click opens it

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.select('p'); const editable = document.createElement('span'); editable.id = 'ed'; editable.contentEditable = 'true'; editable.textContent = 'текст'; document.querySelector('[data-sf-composition-id=p]').append(editable); window.__reached = 0; editable.addEventListener('click', (event) => { if (!event.defaultPrevented) window.__reached += 1; }); o.passive = true; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); return o.passive === true && o.hasAttribute('passive') && o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-tree').tabIndex === -1 && o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-toolbar').hidden && o.querySelector('[aria-selected=true]').dataset.nodeId === 'p'; })()

steps.script: (() => { const ed = document.getElementById('ed'); const box = ed.getBoundingClientRect(); ed.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: box.left + 2, clientY: box.top + 2})); document.querySelector('#o .sf-composition-overlay-tree').focus(); return true; })()
